name: laya_mem_relation_pair
description: Laya-Mem System-One write-side relation judgment. Port of memory/jev_questions.relation_questions for a single pair (new_memory vs candidates[0]). 4 noul per pair: semantic / causes / caused_by / entity. Action emits one label per LinkType if its noul crosses relation_threshold (default 0.60). Caller can pass up to 4 pairs by extending the questions block; default spec handles 1 pair so the model context stays small.

pair_0_semantic.instructions: Would a semantic link between `new_memory.content` and `candidates[0].content` help retrieve a shared specific topic or fact?
pair_0_semantic.truthy: A specific shared topic, fact or event makes the connection useful.
pair_0_semantic.falsy: Only generic conversational vocabulary or no meaningful semantic connection.

pair_0_causes.instructions: Does the event in `new_memory.content` cause, enable or explain the candidate event in `candidates[0].content`?
pair_0_causes.truthy: The supplied accounts support this direction of causal influence.
pair_0_causes.falsy: Only similarity, chronology, a shared entity, or insufficient causal evidence.

pair_0_caused_by.instructions: Does the candidate event in `candidates[0].content` cause, enable or explain the event in `new_memory.content`?
pair_0_caused_by.truthy: The supplied accounts support this direction of causal influence.
pair_0_caused_by.falsy: Only similarity, chronology, a shared entity, or insufficient causal evidence.

pair_0_entity.instructions: Using `new_memory.entities` and `candidates[0].entities`, do any names or aliases refer to the same real-world entity?
pair_0_entity.truthy: Context supports a shared identity despite differing names or aliases.
pair_0_entity.falsy: Distinct entities or insufficient evidence to resolve the alias; similar names alone are insufficient.
